office BP measurements are not reliable enough to be the basis of therapeutic decisions; ambulatory and home BP measurements are the preferred methods to diagnose hypertension and to monitor treatment; the accuracy of BP measuring devices should be assessed and made mandatory by regulatory bodies; and, finally, manufacturers are urged to make their devices compatible with smartphones and to transmit data electronically.
